page.layout: One column of running text, with a marginal note in the left margin beside the chapter opening. Running head at the top, page number at the top left.

main_text.p: participes, salutarem suam gratiam efficaciter nobis distribuit, & omnia disponit ad nostram Salutè. Primò enim Ecclesiam suam per Evangelii praedicationem è mundo collectam, (adeoq; nos) Verbo & Spiritu suo vocat, dein-de vocatos ac venientes ad se guber-nat, ac contra omnes, tum Spirituales, tum Corporales hostes potentissimè defendit. Atq; sic nos suâ morte redemtos efficaciter vocat, & ad fidem vocatos & credentes justificat, & justificatos glorificat. Sic Christum Servatorem suum spectet: agnoscat, colat Christiana fides.
main_text.head: CAPUT III. DE HORRENDA FIDEI Mutilatione, quâ Caput Fidei & salutis hodie à nonnullis rejecatur, quæ hoc loco Christianismi prima est mutilatio.
main_text.p: CHRISTUS Matth. 24. Vi-dete, inquit, ne quis vos seducat. Multi enim venient in Nomine meo dicentes: Ego sum Christus, & multos seducent. Hoc nostro seculo, e-Querela de dissifo Chri-sto.

page.notes: The woodcut initial is a large decorative C, joined to "HRISTUS" as "CHRISTUS". The marginal note reads "Querela de / dissifo Chri- / sto." and is uncertain in its second word, which may be "dissidio" or similar. The page number "24" and the running head are read from a small scan and may be slightly uncertain. Faint show-through from the reverse side is ignored.
